headline: Congress named a Champaign, Illinois post office building after James R. Burgess Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 302 East Green Street in Champaign, Illinois, as the "James R. Burgess Jr. Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or how the building is run.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the new name applies from that date.
